subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram group messages never dispatched despite confirmed Bot API delivery (DMs unaffected)

question: Should maintainers run a live Telegram/current-main repro now to pin the group ingress drop before any repair job is queued?
rationale: The report is strong and matches a documented contract, but source inspection has not identified the failing gate; automation would be guessing without live or replay proof.

options.title: Run live repro first
options.body: Use a real Telegram group or isolated Bot API replay with ingress diagnostics to locate whether the drop happens in polling, spool drain, sequentialization, forum lookup, or context building.

options.title: Ask reporter for current proof
options.body: Wait for an updated current-main repro, screenshot/recording, or redacted diagnostic logs before assigning engineering time.

options.title: Queue a speculative fix
options.body: Start a repair without proof, accepting the risk that it targets the wrong Telegram gate and misses the observed failure.

recommendation.title: Run live repro first
recommendation.body: Use a real Telegram group or isolated Bot API replay with ingress diagnostics to locate whether the drop happens in polling, spool drain, sequentialization, forum lookup, or context building.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on stalled Telegram ingress spool claims makes this the closest current ownership signal for proving the polling/spool side before routing to topic or context owners.
